LanguageData.OmniInterceptor_SetRadiusDesc: Adjust the impact radius of the shield.
LanguageData.OmniInterceptor_InterceptSkyfallersDesc: Toggle whether to intercept incoming skyfallers (e.g. drop pods, meteorites).
LanguageData.OmniInterceptor_ShieldEnabledDesc: Toggle whether the energy shield is active.
LanguageData.OmniInterceptor_AlwaysVisibleDesc: Toggle whether the shield remains visible (at low brightness) even when the building is not selected.
LanguageData.OmniInterceptor_SetSizeDesc: Adjust the width and height of the rectangular shield.
